dataset: NCCD-PF: external engineer-annotated narrow concrete crack masks
dataset_scope: Narrow-crack proxy under 0.3 mm; these labels do not explicitly distinguish fissures from other cracks.
interpretation: Benchmark-level external results, not validation of the uploaded image. Metrics are unavailable for classes without matching ground truth.

crack.summary: NCCD-PF: crack-map IoU 0.102 and Dice 0.125 averaged across 30 narrow-crack positives; generic crack-or-fissure detector recall was 12/30 (40%).
crack.limitations: External narrow-crack sample, not a general crack-severity or field-performance estimate.

fissures.summary: On the narrow-crack proxy, strict fissures detections were 1/30 (3.3%). The multi-class map produced no crack/fissure pixels on 8/8 sampled positives; a fissures detector-positive example had no matched FastSAM mask.
fissures.dataset: NCCD-PF narrow-crack proxy; not explicit fissures labels
fissures.limitations: A dedicated fissures-labelled benchmark is not available in the validation bundle; the narrow-crack proxy is not semantically identical to the model's fissures class.

spalling.summary: No class-matched pixel ground truth was available; numeric spalling mapping accuracy is not reported.
spalling.limitations: FastSAM masks are class-agnostic proposals matched to detector boxes, not supervised spalling masks.

rebar.summary: No class-matched pixel ground truth was available; numeric rebar mapping accuracy is not reported.
rebar.limitations: FastSAM masks are class-agnostic proposals matched to detector boxes, not supervised rebar masks.
